thread.title: Dow Jones Slips; Stock Market Awaits Netflix Earnings | Investor's Business Daily

author: SCOTT LEHTONEN
title: Dow Jones Slips; Stock Market Awaits Netflix Earnings | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The major stock indexes were mixed early Thursday in today's stock market . The Dow Jones industrials lagged behind the other major stock indexes. A number of heavy hitters are due to report after the stock market close, like Dow Jones stock American Express ( AXP ) and IBD 50 stocks Atlassian ( TEAM ) and Netflix ( NFLX ).
X
The tech-heavy Nasdaq composite led the major indexes, with a less than 0.1% gain. The S&P 500 index moved down a fraction, while the Dow Jones industrials fell 0.2%. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Dow Jones Stocks: AMEX Earning On Tap Among the Dow Jones stocks, Apple ( AAPL ) and Home Depot ( HD ) were two of the worst performers in morning trade. Apple stock declined nearly 1%, snapping a two-day win streak. Shares remain over 30% off their 52-week high.
Home Depot stock dropped over 2%, as it pierced its 50-day line. Early Thursday, JPMorgan cut the home improvement retailer's target price from 208 to 203.
American Express ( AXP ) will report its earnings results after the stock market close Thursday. Consensus estimates show EPS rising 13% to $1.79 on revenue of $10.598 billion. The stock is recovering from its recent multi-month lows, but remains below its 50- and 200-day moving average lines. Shares were down 0.1% in morning trade.
Stock Market Earnings: Morgan Stanley, Netflix Stock One day after strong earnings results from global investment banks Goldman Sachs ( GS ) and Bank of America ( BAC ), Morgan Stanley ( MS ) disappointed investors with weaker-than-expected top- and bottom-line results. Morgan Stanley stock fell 6%, giving back the entirety of the last three days of gains.
After the stock market close, IBD 50 stocks Atlassian and Netflix will report their respective quarterly results . Analysts expect software star Atlassian to earn 21 cents per share on sales of $288 million. Shares are extended out of buy range from a cup with handle's 89.920 buy point.
Meanwhile, Netflix is expected to earn 25 cents per share, down 39% year over year. Quarterly revenues are expected to measure $4.208 billion. Netflix stock rebounded powerfully after bottoming on Dec. 26, as it moves up the right side of a new base formation. Netflix stock fell 0.7%.
IBD 50 Stocks To Watch: Lululemon Outperforms Among the leading growth stocks , retail stock Lululemon ( LULU ) advanced over 2%, extending a win streak to five trading sessions. The Leaderboard watch list stock is moving up the right side of a new base.
